title: The oxygen crossing
hook: Predict where the illustrated process leads.

knows: Living systems move or transform matter and signals.
doesNotKnow: Oxygen diffuses from alveolar air into the adjacent pulmonary capillary blood, driven by a partial-pressure difference. The figure shows the net direction, not individual molecular paths.

misconception: The illustrated process sends matter or signals to the wrong destination.
objective: Explain o₂ diffuses from alveolar air to blood in this example.

claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: In a lung with the usual gas-pressure gradients, where does oxygen move from an alveolus? Oxygen diffuses from alveolar air into the adjacent pulmonary capillary blood, driven by a partial-pressure difference. The figure shows the net direction, not individual molecular paths.
The diagram shows a selected step, not all structures, inputs, products or intermediate events.
